page.description: GParted Live editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A small live system built around GParted: boot it from a USB stick to create, resize, move, check and copy partitions on a disk that is not mounted.
pros: The standard tool for resizing and moving partitions from outside the installed system.
Runs from a USB stick or CD without installing anything.
Supports ext2/3/4, Btrfs, XFS, FAT, NTFS and more.
cons: A single-purpose tool, not a desktop system.
The publisher lists MD5 only, so the SHA-256 here was computed by ROMinit.
Repartitioning can destroy data; a backup is required first.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for GParted Live; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO to a USB stick with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick. Boot from it and GParted starts automatically. Repartitioning the wrong disk destroys its data.
